The Midnight Cabal is a rumor with a lockpick smile, present only in whispers and impossible coincidences. Nobody reliable claims to have hired the Midnight Cabal. That is part of the brand, if it is a brand. The stories always include one locked door, one unpaid debt, and one witness who insists the candle blew out by itself. The name is spoken the way people speak about a storm they hope will miss them. Quietly, with one glance toward the nearest door.
